content: Amina had always wanted to become a doctor. As a child, she watched her mother walk long distances to the nearest clinic, and she promised herself that one day she would bring healthcare to her village. She studied hard, often reading by the light of a kerosene lamp when the power failed. Her teachers noticed her determination and encouraged her. Years later, Amina returned to her village as a qualified doctor and opened a small clinic. The villagers celebrated, for their daughter had kept her promise.

content: Tunde was the youngest farmer in his village, but he was also the most hardworking. While others planted the same crops every year, Tunde tried new methods he had learned from agricultural extension officers. He planted maize and beans together, used compost to enrich the soil, and dug a small channel to bring water to his farm. At harvest time, his yield was the best in the village. The elders praised him, and many young people began to follow his example.
